technology_name: A METHOD OF IN-SITU SYNTHESIZING POLYMER/METAL OXIDE ULTRA-THIN COMPOSITE SHEETS AT A LIQUID-LIQUID INTERFACE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Fabricating ultra-thin, completely uniform polymer/metal-oxide sheets normally requires complex multi-stage setups that cause localized metal particle clumping.
description: An eco-friendly, single-step liquid-liquid interfacial assembly technique utilizing a time-dependent self-assembly protocol of metal oxides to form highly crystalline, macro-defect-free manganese oxide-conducting polymer sheets.
applications: Flexible electronics substrate layers, smart wear sensor grids, high-density energy storage membranes, and anti-static electromagnetic shielding wraps.
